fields.name: pre_press_target
fields.description: Store the [y, x] center of the target on which the instruction's cube rested immediately before the demonstration button press. Identify it from the last completed placement before that press, not from later placements or the cube's final position. Use the selected target's center in the execution-start scene, matching it through the demonstration despite occlusion and small centroid shifts. Write this at decision step #1 and retain it unchanged thereafter. For episodes 7, 31, 47, 52, and 89 respectively, the values at both decision steps are [126, 145], [115, 152], [80, 162], [101, 163], and [76, 104]. e.g. [126, 145]
